service.description: The manual data service of the search document BossPeopleQualification: a qualification's holder's employments (fromRelationships) are kept only while not ended (no end recorded), so the employers the organization row filter reads are the current ones; a holder with none left gains the field noCurrentEmployment, which the document's post-query condition leaves out, so the feed deletes the document. The document carries every employment's end, so ending one is a write of a document field the feed takes (an end in a SQL condition of the document stopped the write from being fed, and the document stayed). An identity document or a work permit (QualIdentityDocument, QualWorkPermit) gains restrictedType, which a second post-query condition leaves out, so the dataset never holds one (impl-people P28, the user's call of Nov 13, 2026). Reads nothing.
